en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over the city of Graz from an elevated vantage point. In the foreground on the left is a steep-roofed tower among trees, looking down over dense historic rooftops, church spires and civic buildings stretching into the distance with hills on the horizon. Printed German captions and publisher information appear at the bottom, along with cursive handwritten notes.
